automatic_writers.note: Writers that are part of the product. A lane controller or a supervised guard joins this list when its design ships. config_sources names a writer by config_audit.source when its actor also writes by hand: metal-box-stop-loop is the box stop loop, which runs as the systemd unit virev-box-stop.service since Crawler VP p173 closed on 10-16 00:40Z, while actor metal also writes by hand from source metal-owner. canary-roster is the engage canary roster refill (crawler-v3 canary_roster.py), which keeps the roster at the owner's 10% of active accounts.

exempt.note: An owner order quoted in the reason or opened with 'Owner order', or a named A/B experiment with its restore, is a decision, not a hand fix. The staging `.venv/bin/python - 3600 8` exec and the prod `python -c "$0"` exec of the script that opens 'Daily B2 version inventory for ONE bucket' are the declared unit virev-b2-inventory.service (host.yml --tags b2-inventory, its timer; on prod run-inventory.sh calls inventory.py host influencer-prod virev-prod-crawler-worker, read 10-18 05:34Z), so neither is a hand-started process. A board note on a d3 run or the d3 precheck reports this duty's own work, not a hand fix.
exempt.box_exec_regex: \.venv/bin/python - 3600 8$|Daily B2 version inventory for ONE bucket
